name: 46218 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46218 (Indianapolis) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46218 (Indianapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
